title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 — model/provider/harness field test

post_audit_notes.D1: Reproduced upstream PR #7151 verbatim (including changelog/6947.bugfix.rst and docstring typo 'pytestfunct'). Reports cleanup exceptions, but runs doCleanups() before entering --pdb and before deferred tearDown().
post_audit_notes.D2-r3_D3_D4: Independently derived teardown() try/finally doCleanups() fix. Preserves --pdb post-mortem state and tearDown -> cleanup ordering, but swallows exceptions raised inside addCleanup callbacks after a test failure.
